chapter: Inside the Basie rhythm section and band family
title: Feeling at home in the rhythm section; the All American Rhythm Section
summary: It took him a while to feel he belonged; he took his cue from Basie and enjoyed the rhythm-section records.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

It took a while.
Mm hmm.

And, when he starts, I'm right with him, you see. And, on occasion they do -- you know, like, whatever is happening -- as I say I, you know, I keep an eye on Basie, more or less.
Yeah.

That was for Decca, and --

Yeah.
